aiSetup.instructionsBody: Privately add GEMINI_API_KEY and a supported AI_MODEL to the server environment. The default endpoint is Google Gemini’s OpenAI-compatible endpoint. After completing the reviews below, set AI_STUDY_BUDDY_ENABLED and DATA_COLLECTION_ENABLED to true and restart or redeploy. See AI-SETUP.md in the project.

achievement.stage: Design preview only: downloading works in your browser. Draft storage, publishing and public sharing will be enabled in the next stage. Do not upload real student photos without appropriate consent.
achievement.photoHelp: Choose or drop a JPEG, PNG or WebP image (maximum 8 MB). A local copy is processed in your browser.
achievement.consent: I have parent or guardian consent to publish this minor’s photo.
achievement.consentHelp: Obtain and retain consent before publishing a child’s photo. A checked box does not verify consent.
achievement.error: Could not prepare the image. Try a smaller photo or another browser.
achievement.fileError: Choose a valid JPEG, PNG or WebP image under 8 MB.
achievement.copyUnsupported: This browser cannot copy images; use Download PNG.
achievement.draftUnavailable: Private draft saving and publication are disabled in this environment.
achievement.sample: Sample card — illustration, not a real prize photo
achievement.siteHelp: Enter your public site URL; no address has been assumed.
achievement.subject: Subject (optional)
achievement.nameHelp: One name per line. Choose one group card or select an individual to export separately.
achievement.faceHelp: Review the crop and focus: faces are not detected automatically. Text stays outside the photo.
achievement.siteMissing: Official website URL is not configured in Site Settings. No placeholder address or QR code will be exported.
achievement.textOverflow: Text does not fit at the minimum readable size. Shorten names, title or caption before exporting.
achievement.workflowError: The operation failed. Check the details, your session and server configuration.
achievement.workflowDisabled: Achievement saving and publishing are disabled until the privacy and deployment reviews are complete.
achievement.privateWarning: Drafts are restricted to administrators. Public cards can be viewed and copied by anyone after publication. Only 100 recent records are shown.
achievement.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete this draft and its stored images?
achievement.consentNotice: Publishing a student photo or achievement is a public disclosure. Check the consent documentation and scope before proceeding.
achievement.guardianConfirmed: I have verified the documented guardian permission to publish.
achievement.everyoneConfirmed: The permission covers every named and pictured person, and the intended public use.
achievement.evidenceHelp: Use a reference to a securely held consent record, not private documents or phone numbers. A checkbox alone does not prove consent.
achievement.withdrawalWarning: Withdrawal removes the site copy, but copies already saved or cached by others may remain.
achievement.draftConsentNotice: To save a private draft, select a photo, complete the required fields, confirm guardian consent below, and enter a consent record reference of at least five characters. Do not enter private evidence itself.
achievement.draftError: Could not save. Check the photo, required fields, consent reference, image size and configuration.
achievement.changedDuringSave: The card changed while saving. Please try again.
achievement.workflowStage: Private drafts and publication are enabled in this environment. Verify consent and image placement before use.
achievement.replaceEditorConfirm: Load this draft and replace the current editor contents?
achievement.draftLoaded: Draft loaded. Confirm consent again before saving.
achievement.saveAsNew: Save as a new draft instead

aiTest.title: Test provider connection
aiTest.description: Sends a fixed, non-personal question to the configured provider. No student data or key is displayed.
aiTest.ok: The provider returned an answer. Now test the student chat with a test account.
aiTest.configuration: Configuration or safety flags are missing.
aiTest.forbidden: Your session or site origin could not be verified. Sign in again and check NEXTAUTH_URL.
aiTest.rate: Too many diagnostic tests. Try again later.
aiTest.key: The provider rejected the key or account permissions. Check the private key in your hosting settings.
aiTest.quota: The provider reported a quota or rate limit. Check your provider project and free-tier availability.
aiTest.model: The provider rejected the model or request. Check the model ID and access.
aiTest.provider: The provider could not complete the test. Check its status and project settings.
aiTest.empty: The provider returned no text. Check the model and its token/thinking settings.
aiTest.network: The provider could not be reached or the test timed out.
